lenses.summary: Numerically this report is very clean: every headline number reproduces exactly from the cited JSONs. B1 buckets (48.41/45.93/4.0/1.25/0.41, sum 100.0), 461 ms/step kernel time and the abs-ms column, all itemized pointwise sub-buckets and named-kernel percentages, op-level producer counts (1473x/574x/1381x per step, 75.4/72.6 ms), the 15.8% fp32 FFMA sum (exactly 10 sm80_xmma_gemm_f32f32 kernels), the B3 lean cell (40.33%, 4.0% cast, 329 ms, GEMM 170.4 ms, 51.8%), and both MFU values recompute bit-exactly from 4*N*tokens/(step_median*989.5e12) with N=7,241,732,096 (0.24704/0.34056, +9.35 pts, -27.46% step time). Cross-references to the build report (49.1/45.5/4.1/1.2/0.0 from train_gemmshare.json, baseline 0.2464 from baseline_B2.json, panel ~7pt/39% estimate), the anchor md5, and the shim's two-symbol GOT surface all verify against artifacts. The seven findings are all minor bookkeeping/presentation issues — internal double-counting in B2's illustrative percentages, an integrity-section clock range contradicted by mfu_lean_recipe.json (in the conservative direction), and a few numbers ("PW_OPTIMIZER_FOREACH"/multi_tensor_apply, GEMM-time MFU 0.66, "28 steps") whose stated provenance does not match where they actually trace. None changes the CONFIRMED/0%-reachable/out-of-moat verdict.

Computing FLOPs ÷ (GEMM kernel time × peak) from the same artifacts gives 4·7241732096·4096 / (0.518·0.329 s · 989.5e12) = 0.7035. lenses.summary: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the artifacts (48.4/45.9 buckets, sub-buckets to 0.1pt, 15.8% FFMA from 10 kernels, 461→329 ms/step, MFU 0.2470/0.3406 = +9.35pt, anchor md5 matches). The B3 causal attribution survives the confound check — but only because the discarded bf16+fp32 arm (which the report never uses as a control) shows base-dtype change is null (pointwise 47.9% vs 48.4%, 467.5 vs 461 ms/step). The one material problem is B2's load-bearing premise: the substrate source contradicts "cublasGemmEx + cublasLtMatmul is the entire substitution surface" — cipher_inject.c also registers GOT patches for three ATen SDPA ::call symbols, six vLLM flash-attn patterns, machete mm_dispatch, and dlsym/dlvsym, and the SDPA trampolines receive full tensor semantics, undercutting the categorical "no tensor semantics at the boundary" wall framing (though no patched symbol reaches the POINTWISE bucket, so the 0%-of-pointwise verdict itself survives). Several minor disclosure/precision issues in the confirmation methodology and integrity section.

findings.title: B2's 'entire substitution surface' premise is false per substrate source; wall framing overstated

The cudnn-SDPA patch is directly relevant to THIS workload (op table shows aten::_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward; ATTENTION bucket 4.0%). None of the extra patches reach the POINTWISE bucket, so '0% of pointwise reachable' survives on the artifacts — but the stated premise is factually wrong, and the existence of a working ATen-symbol-level GOT mechanism with tensor semantics means the categorical 'tensor semantics do not exist at the interception boundary' wall is not the whole story: the report never argues why that demonstrated mechanism could not be extended to e.g. at::_ops::mul::call / at::_ops::_to_copy::call (the honest wall there is: new-build registrations + per-op substitution of memory-bound elementwise kernels gains ~nothing without cross-op fusion + the suppression/buffer-ownership wall).

Replace the categorical no-tensor-semantics wall with the accurate composite: no pointwise-relevant symbol is on the as-built surface; extending the proven at::_ops GOT mechanism to elementwise ops would be a new build and cannot fuse cross-op chains (the actual source of the pointwise cost), and still hits the suppression/buffer-ownership wall.

findings.title: B3 headline is a two-variable comparison; the in-dir single-variable control proves the attribution but is never cited as such, and no MFU was measured for it
findings.report_claim: "removing the fp32-adapter recipe (bf16 adapters) cuts pointwise 48.4→40.3 % and lifts MFU 24.7 %→34.1 % (+9.4 pts)"; table column header "lean (bf16+bf16)" vs "build recipe (fp16+fp32 adapters)"; "PW_MIXED_DTYPE_ADD_MUL ... pure fp32-adapter artifact"; "+9.4 MFU pts from a recipe change"

verdict.reasoning: CONFIRMED against source. (1) cipher_rt_cublas_shim.c:325-334 registers only cublasGemmEx+cublasLtMatmul — true in isolation — but cipher_inject.c cipher_v2_init_body additionally arms at injection: cipher_rt_attn_register_got() (line 82; cipher_rt_attn_dispatch.cpp:563-571 GOT-patches at::_ops::_scaled_dot_product_{flash,efficient,cudnn}_attention::call, trampolines at lines 398-520 receive full const at::Tensor& args with fill_view extracting ptr/sizes), cipher_rt_attn_6pattern_init() (line 65; got_register at cipher_rt_attn_6pattern.c:145), cipher_rt_machete_intercept_init() (line 64; machete::mm_dispatch), cipher_rt_cublaslt_variants_init()+cipher_rt_dlsym_hook_init() (lines 90-91; 17 cublasLt*Matmul variant trampolines + dlsym/dlvsym), plus cipher_rt_intercept_init() (line 101; cuGetProcAddress/cuLaunchKernel variants — surface the reviewer didn't even cite). So the report's "That is the entire substitution surface" and the verdict's "interception surface (cublasGemmEx + cublasLtMatmul only)" are factually false per the substrate's own injection entrypoint, despite being labeled "source-grounded". (2) Workload relevance confirmed: b1_itemized_fp16_fp32adapters.json op_table_top40 shows aten::_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention 4.68 ms/step + _backward 15.93 ms/step, ATTENTION bucket 4.0% — the patched cudnn-SDPA ::call family is exercised by this exact workload. (3) B2's categorical wall "tensor semantics that do not exist there" is contradicted by the armed SDPA trampolines, which demonstrate a working ATen-symbol GOT mechanism WITH tensor semantics; the honest wall for pointwise is: no pointwise-relevant symbol on the as-built surface + extending at::_ops GOT to elementwise ops is a new build that gains ~nothing without cross-op fusion + the suppression/buffer-ownership wall (which B2 item 2 does state correctly for casts). (4) The numeric conclusion survives: pointwise_members are all ATen TensorIterator elementwise/copy/cat kernels, none reachable via any patched symbol, so "0% pointwise dispatch-boundary-reachable", the 48.4%/40.3% shares, and +9.4 MFU pts all stand; anchor md5 2edba0d2136f8ede4713d90a8f7cd55f verified. Tempering nuance: as-built the SDPA trampolines abort on HANDLED (return-construction is v1.5 work) and machete/6-pattern are passthrough-counter-only, so a strict can-substitute-today reading partially defends "substitution surface" — but the verdict says "interception surface ... only" (unambiguously false) and the impossibility framing is what the out-of-moat closure rests on. Material because the false premise sits in the verdict itself and converts a new-build+economics wall into a categorical impossibility, which would mislead a decision-maker about whether the substrate position could ever address training pointwise; fix is the reviewer's suggested rewrite, no numbers change.

lenses.summary: Numerically the report is clean: every headline figure (48.4% pointwise, 15.8% FFMA over 10 kernels, 40.3% lean, 0.2470->0.3406 MFU, 461->329 ms/step, op counts) reproduces exactly from the evidence JSONs, both self-caught issues are auditable in the artifacts, and no retracted numbers are reused. The honesty problems are at the verdict layer: the close ("single-tenant training MFU closes as out-of-moat") reads broader than the HF-eager LoRA-finetune/one-model/one-batch/single-GPU evidence, and the +9.4pt bf16-adapter lever is pitched twice (verdict and closing) without the quality caveat that appears only once in B3. verdict.reasoning:
Re-derived from artifacts. The literal claim in cipher_rt_cublas_shim.c is correct: lines 325-336 GOT-register exactly cublasGemmEx + cublasLtMatmul, and cublasGetStream_v2 is only dlsym-resolved (lines 116-118), not patched. BUT the report's framing 'that is the entire substitution surface' (B2) is contradicted by the substrate's actual injection path and by the frozen anchor binary the report freezes:
- cipher_inject.c line 82 calls cipher_rt_attn_register_got() (defined in cipher_rt_attn_dispatch.cpp:563-573), which GOT-registers THREE ATen SDPA ::call symbols (flash/efficient/cudnn scaled_dot_product_attention). The reviewer missed this one; it is in libtorch, not just vLLM.
- cipher_inject.c line 65 -> cipher_rt_attn_6pattern_init() registers 4 vLLM mangled attention symbols (cipher_rt_attn_6pattern.c:145, SYM_P1/P2/P5/P6).
- cipher_inject.c line 64 -> cipher_rt_machete_intercept_init() registers _ZN7machete11mm_dispatchENS_6MMArgsE (cipher_rt_machete_intercept.c:116).
- cipher_inject.c lines 90-91 -> cipher_rt_cublaslt_variants_init() registers 17 cublasLt*Matmul variants into the dlsym registry, then cipher_rt_dlsym_hook_init() GOT-patches dlsym/dlvsym (cipher_rt_dlsym_hook.c:187/193).
- nm -D on the anchor (md5 confirmed 2edba0d2136f8ede4713d90a8f7cd55f, matches claim) exports cipher_rt_attn_register_got, cipher_rt_attn_6pattern_init, cipher_rt_machete_intercept_init, _ZN7machete11mm_dispatchENS_6MMArgsE, cipher_rt_dlsym_hook_init.
So the source-grounded premise as STATED is false (understated — even more so than the reviewer noted, since they missed the 3 libtorch SDPA hooks).
HOWEVER: every extra hook targets attention (SDPA / vLLM FA2/FA3/FMHA/paged-attn) or vLLM GEMM paths (machete) or dlsym for cuBLASLt variant coverage. NONE reaches the ATen elementwise/TensorIterator pointwise kernels (add/mul/cast/norm/rope/silu/optimizer) that constitute the report's pointwise bucket. The 0%-of-pointwise-reachability conclusion, the reachability fraction, B3's artifact/intrinsic split, and the verdict all survive verbatim under the full surface. No number changes. The report's own B2 bullet 3 already reasons about cuBLASLt epilogues, showing it knows the surface is richer than two symbols. This is a precision/accuracy defect in a premise the report markets as 'source-grounded', not a decision-altering error. Does not mislead a decision-maker on the verdict; warrants the suggested rescoping but is minor.
